edition_encoded: Cat Act 2011 (WA), Act No. 055 of 2011, consolidated version 00-l0-01 (currency start 25 September 2025); Cat Regulations 2012 and Cat (Uniform Local Provisions) Regulations 2013 as gazetted; Cat Amendment (Local Laws) Bill 2026 print 53-1 as introduced, which is also the print before the Legislative Council.

checks.command: l4 run cat-cases.l4 ; l4 run cat-part6-cases.l4
checks.note: `l4 run` exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics must be read, not the exit code.

scope: Part 1 and Part 2 Divisions 1-3 of the Act; the Cat Regulations 2012 (regs 9, 10, 12); and Part 6 s 79 in TWO versions - as in force, and as the Cat Amendment (Local Laws) Bill 2026 (Bill 53) cl 4 would amend it, so that the Bill's effect is the difference between two arms rather than a claim about it. NOT ENCODED: Part 2 Divisions 4-5, Parts 3-5 and 7, the rest of Part 6, and the Cat (Uniform Local Provisions) Regulations 2013. s 80 and the Veterinary Practice Act 2021 are facts supplied.
